newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Yachting: Peter Campbell's Rhumbline Column.
newsitem.headline: Australian Yachting: Peter Campbell's Rhumbline Column.

text.p: The controversial plan for the Olympic yachting site at Rushcutters Bay will be released either today or early next week, confirming that the old Navy site and adjacent parkland will be shore base headquarters for the Sydney 2000 Olympic sailing, over-riding the strong objections of some local residents.
